# Balancing weight

$$f(x)=f(x|d)\omega(d,x)$$

$$\omega(d,x)=\frac{f(x)}{f(x|d)}$$

$$=\frac{f(d)}{f(d|x)}$$

- OLS directly estimate the balancing weights with moment balancing.

- 


# Example

```{r, dev='ragg_png'}

Result <- list()
set.seed(111)

library(tidyverse)

Data <- read_csv("Public/Example.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Y = Price
  ) |>
  mutate(
    EmbedSize = mean(Size),
    EmbedTenure = mean(Tenure),
    EmbedDistance = mean(Size),
    .by = District
  )

Group <- sample(
  1:2,
  nrow(Data),
  replace = TRUE
)

Data$HatY_OLS_D1 <- lm(
  Y ~ (Tenure + Size + Distance + District)**2 +
    splines::bs(Size, 3) + splines::bs(Tenure, 3) + splines::bs(Distance, 3),
  Data,
  subset = Group == 1 & D == 1
) |>
  predict(Data) |>
  as.numeric()

Data$HatY_OLS_D0 <- lm(
  Y ~ (Tenure + Size + Distance + District)**2 +
    splines::bs(Size, 3) + splines::bs(Tenure, 3) + splines::bs(Distance, 3),
  Data,
  subset = Group == 1 & D == 0
) |>
  predict(Data) |>
  as.numeric()

Data$HatD_OLS <- lm(
  D ~ (Tenure + Size + Distance + District)**2 +
    splines::bs(Size, 3) + splines::bs(Tenure, 3) + splines::bs(Distance, 3),
  Data,
  subset = Group == 1
) |>
  predict(Data) |>
  as.numeric()


Data$HatY_RF_D1 <- ranger::ranger(
  Y ~ Tenure + Size + Distance + EmbedSize + EmbedTenure + EmbedDistance,
  data = Data[Group == 1 & Data$D == 1, ]
) |>
  predict(Data) |>
  magrittr::extract2("predictions") |>
  as.numeric()

Data$HatY_RF_D0 <- ranger::ranger(
  Y ~ Tenure + Size + Distance + EmbedSize + EmbedTenure + EmbedDistance,
  data = Data[Group == 1 & Data$D == 0, ]
) |>
  predict(Data) |>
  magrittr::extract2("predictions") |>
  as.numeric()

Data$HatD_RF <- ranger::ranger(
  D ~ Tenure + Size + Distance + EmbedSize + EmbedTenure + EmbedDistance,
  data = Data[Group == 1,]
) |>
  predict(Data) |>
  magrittr::extract2("predictions") |>
  as.numeric()


Data$HatY_D1 <- lm(Y ~ HatY_RF_D1 + HatY_OLS_D1,
  Data,
  subset = Group == 2 & D == 1
) |>
  predict(Data) |>
  as.numeric()

Data$HatY_D0 <- lm(Y ~ HatY_RF_D0 + HatY_OLS_D0,
  Data,
  subset = Group == 2 & D == 0
) |>
  predict(Data) |>
  as.numeric()

Data$HatD <- lm(D ~ HatD_RF + HatD_OLS,
  Data,
  subset = Group == 2
) |>
  predict(Data) |>
  as.numeric()

MeanD = mean(Data$D)

Data$WeightIPW = case_when(
  Data$D == 1 ~ MeanD/(Data$HatD),
  Data$D == 0 ~ (1 - MeanD)/(1 - Data$HatD)
)

Data$WeightOLS = lmw::lmw(
  ~ D + Tenure + Size + Distance + District,
  Data,
  method = "MRI"
) |>
  magrittr::extract2("weights")

Data$WeightEbal = WeightIt::weightit(
  D ~ Tenure + Size + Distance + District,
  Data,
  method = "ebal",
  estimand = "ATE"
  ) |> 
  magrittr::extract2("weights")


boxplot(
  Data$WeightOLS,
  Data$WeightEbal,
  Data$WeightIPW
)

Result$StackY_D1 = lm(Y ~ HatY_RF_D1 + HatY_OLS_D1,
  Data,
  subset = Group == 2 & D == 1
)


Result$StackY_D0 = lm(Y ~ HatY_RF_D0 + HatY_OLS_D0,
  Data,
  subset = Group == 2 & D == 0
)

Result$Data = Data

Plugin <- Data$HatY_D1 - Data$HatY_D0


Adjust <- case_when(
  Data$D == 1 ~ (Data$WeightEbal/MeanD) * (Data$Y - Data$HatY_D1),
  Data$D == 0 ~ -(Data$WeightEbal/(1 - MeanD)) * (Data$Y - Data$HatY_D0)
)

AdjustIPW <- case_when(
  Data$D == 1 ~ (Data$WeightIPW/MeanD) * (Data$Y - Data$HatY_D1),
  Data$D == 0 ~ -(Data$WeightIPW/(1 - MeanD)) * (Data$Y - Data$HatY_D0)
)

Score <- Plugin + Adjust

ScoreIPW <- Plugin + AdjustIPW

estimatr::lm_robust(
  Y ~ D + Tenure + Size + Distance + District,
  Data,
  subset = Group == 2
) |>
  generics::tidy() |>
  filter(term == "D") |>
  mutate(
    Method = "OLS"
  ) |>
  bind_rows(
    estimatr::lm_robust(
      Score ~ 1,
      subset = Group == 2
    ) |>
      generics::tidy() |>
      mutate(
        Method = "OLS + Agumentaiton"
      )
  ) |>
  bind_rows(
    estimatr::lm_robust(
      ScoreIPW ~ 1,
      subset = Group == 2
    ) |>
      generics::tidy() |>
      mutate(
        Method = "AIPW"
      )
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      y = Method,
      x = estimate,
      xmin = conf.low,
      xmax = conf.high,
      label = str_c(estimate |> round(3)," (", std.error |> round(3),")")
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_pointrange() +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel()

```
